title: DL Research Runs Ledger Row
description: A row is either an experiment row (row_type absent or 'run', v1-compatible) or a 'critic_verdict' row (v2). ledger_version is an explicit marker (row-level field, e.g. on the first row) that opts a file into v2 validation rules; its absence means the file validates under v1 rules unchanged.

then.description: Critic verdict row (v2 only): a mechanical record that a critic reviewed a run/experiment, used to gate 'promote' decisions. Exempt from run-row REQUIRED fields. Note: 'verdict' here is pass/block/revise, distinct from the run row's kept/killed/inconclusive/invalid 'verdict' enum.

target_run_id.description: The run_id (or experiment_id) of the run row this verdict targets.

ledger_version.description: Explicit ledger format marker, e.g. '2'. Row-level field, conventionally set on the first row of the file. Absent (never inferred) means the file validates under v1 rules unchanged.

row_type.description: Row discriminator. Absent or 'run' = experiment row (v1-compatible). 'critic_verdict' = mechanical critic-verdict row (v2), exempt from run-row REQUIRED fields.

target_run_id.description: critic_verdict rows only: the run_id (or experiment_id) this verdict targets.

created_at.description: critic_verdict rows only: ISO-8601 timestamp the verdict was recorded.

experiment_id.description: Canonical experiment ID. Multi-route H/E studies use the dotted form (e.g. 'H1.E1'); single-route studies use 'E1', 'E2', ...

track_id.description: Hypothesis track (e.g. 'H1'). Null for single-route studies.

slug.description: Filename-safe identifier including the experiment name (e.g. 'H1E1-token-pruning'). Used in run names and directory paths. Required for any launched run.

verdict.description: Run rows (row_type absent/'run'): kept/killed/inconclusive/invalid. critic_verdict rows: pass/block/revise — see the 'if row_type==critic_verdict' branch below for the enum in effect.
